title: Finite locally constant sheaves admit finite constant local models
statement: Let T be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and E a sheaf of sets [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets] on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. If E is constant [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] on the members of some etale cover and all its separably closed geometric stalks are finite, there is an etale cover on every member U of which the restriction of E is isomorphic to a constant sheaf of some finite set S. The sets S may have different sizes and may lie in the next universe.

proof.text: Use the essential-image definition of a constant sheaf to choose its constant value on each cover member. Delete empty members, retaining a jointly surjective cover indexed by their subtype, which is empty when the base is empty. On each retained member choose a point and the separable closure of its residue field, giving a geometric point s of that member and a composed point of the base. Localize the base site point at the lift s. FunctorToTypes.fromOverFunctorElementsEquivalence identifies its pointed neighbourhoods with the over-category of the original pointed neighbourhood category; Over.initial_forget and Functor.Final.colimitIso identify the restricted stalk with the original stalk. Apply the local constant-sheaf isomorphism and the source library's sheafFiberConstantSheafIso to identify the constant value with that stalk. IsFiniteSheaf makes the stalk finitely generated; transport this property through the isomorphism and use ConcreteCategory.isFinitelyGenerated_iff_finite to make the constant value finite.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03RV, local finite-value argument, with the stalk comparison of Tag 03Q1; implemented using Mathlib point localization, initial over-category forgetful functor, and final-functor colimit comparison, and the source library constant-sheaf stalk isomorphism

lean.statement:
theorem finiteLocallyConstant_exists_local_models
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (E : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (hloc : ∃ 𝒰 : Cover.{u} etalePrecoverage T, ∀ i,
      (E.over (𝒰.etalePrecoverageToEtale i)).IsConstant
        (T.smallEtaleTopology.over (𝒰.etalePrecoverageToEtale i)))
    (hfin : IsFiniteSheaf E) :
    ∃ 𝒰 : Cover.{u} etalePrecoverage T, ∀ i,
      ∃ S : Type (u + 1), Finite S ∧
        Nonempty ((E.over (𝒰.etalePrecoverageToEtale i)) ≅
          (constantSheaf (T.smallEtaleTopology.over
            (𝒰.etalePrecoverageToEtale i)) (Type (u + 1))).obj S)
